documents.text: Anvil Point Station stands on the Sable Reach and was founded in 2021. The station is directed by Owen Fenn and has 70 berths. It stays open through the winter and supports visiting field parties.
documents.title: Anvil Point Station

documents.text: The Marrow Ridge Traverse took place in 2044 and ran for 10 weeks. It was led by Yuki Verhoeven. The party was based at Corvid Bay Station and travelled aboard RV Northlight. Field notes and raw logs from the Marrow Ridge Traverse are held in the institute archive.
documents.title: The Marrow Ridge Traverse
